customer: Embedded developers, network/automation service engineers, lab technicians and field operators who need a compact serial/network/CAN service terminal rather than a general-purpose mini laptop.
position: A remanufactured IP65-class industrial-tablet cyberdeck with integrated keyboard/pointing dock and protected service I/O, priced below new GPD-style engineering mini PCs while offering more native field connectivity.

economics.note: Screening economics only. Exact donor lot price, battery replacement rate, dock mechanics, FieldIO BOM and buyer willingness to pay remain unverified.

approved_donor.required_identity: AIM8I / Intel Atom x5-Z8350 Windows 10 IoT variant
retained_value: Intel Atom x5-Z8350 compute with 2 GB RAM
14-pin extension connector carrying USB 2.0 + UART + power
Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/NFC and optional WWAN capabilities where present

current_market_observation.note: Multiple public listings exist around NT$2,000-2,500, but exact qualified lot depth and battery/functional yield are not established.

retained_capabilities: industrial tablet enclosure and touch display
battery and charging subsystem only when condition tests pass
existing compute platform for terminal/browser/SSH/serial tooling

new_hardware.mechanical_form: clamshell/hinged keyboard dock without opening the donor tablet
new_hardware.interface_strategy: use documented dock/extension interfaces or external USB only; no battery pack modification
baseline_functions: Gigabit Ethernet via verified USB 3.0 path

software.role: field-service terminal, serial/network console, offline documentation and HS remote-agent front end
candidate_platforms: existing licensed Windows 10 IoT image when transfer/use rights and security posture are acceptable
independently validated lightweight Linux image only after touch/suspend/wireless/dock compatibility passes
release_checks: keyboard and pointing-device full key/input test
exact donor serial/revision + dock revision + FieldIO revision + software image hash in QA receipt

explicit_non_goals: certified replacement for current rugged field computers
retaining IP65 after adding an unqualified dock
next_gate: Qualify one AIM8I donor, measure battery/functional condition, verify the documented pogo interfaces electrically and prove a minimum usable terminal OS before authorizing FieldDock/FieldIO schematic and mechanical design.
